features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you imbue a weapon with light for 10 minutes: + Cha modifier to attack rolls, 20-foot light, and its damage becomes Radiant.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.desc: You and allies within 10 feet are immune to the Charmed condition.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.desc: When you use Divine Smite, you grant allies within 10 feet Half Cover.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.desc: As an action, you emit radiance for 1 minute: enemies within 30 feet take Radiant damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by Fiends or Undead.
